_readme: Merchant-facing words for HSN/SAC codes. Rates live in hsn.master.ts and never appear here —
this file can be edited, translated and reviewed without anyone touching a tax figure.
name       plain-language label shown in the picker, instead of the official tariff wording
definition what belongs under this code, and the trap that makes it ambiguous
aliases    every word a merchant might type. Transliterated Hindi belongs here too --
merchants on the English UI still type 'kameez' and 'chappal'. The loader merges
aliases across ALL locales for matching, so an alias only needs listing once.
notHere    code -> label cross-references for the neighbours people confuse this with.
Codes absent from this file fall back to the official tariff wording in the manifest, so
coverage can grow with what merchants actually search for rather than being written up front.

6205.name: Men's shirts (woven)
6205.definition: Formal and casual shirts for men, made from woven cloth. If the fabric stretches like a T-shirt, it is knitted and belongs to 6105 instead.

6105.name: Men's shirts (knitted)
6105.definition: Men's shirts made from knitted or crocheted fabric — polo shirts, jersey shirts, anything with natural stretch.

6109.name: T-shirts, vests and singlets
6109.definition: Knitted T-shirts, round-neck tees, banians and vests, for any gender.

6110.name: Sweaters, hoodies and cardigans
6110.definition: Knitted upper-body warmers — pullovers, jerseys, cardigans, sweatshirts and hoodies.

6203.name: Men's trousers, suits and jackets (woven)
6203.definition: Woven lower and outer wear for men — trousers, formal pants, jeans, shorts, blazers and suits.

6204.name: Women's dresses, tops and trousers (woven)
6204.definition: Woven outerwear for women — dresses, skirts, trousers, suits and jackets.

6206.name: Women's blouses and tops (woven)
6206.definition: Woven shirts, blouses and tops for women, including saree blouses.

6211.name: Sarees, kurtas, track suits and swimwear
6211.definition: Garments that don't fit the shirt/trouser headings — sarees, salwar-kameez sets, kurtas, dhotis, track suits and swimwear.

6214.name: Shawls, scarves and dupattas
6214.definition: Shawls, stoles, mufflers, dupattas, chunnis and veils.

6115.name: Socks, stockings and tights
6115.definition: Knitted hosiery for the legs and feet — socks, stockings, tights, leggings sold as hosiery.

6107.name: Men's innerwear and nightwear
6107.definition: Knitted underwear, briefs, nightwear, pyjamas and bathrobes for men.

6108.name: Women's innerwear and nightwear
6108.definition: Knitted slips, petticoats, briefs, nightdresses and negligees for women.

6111.name: Babies' garments (knitted)
6111.definition: Knitted clothing and accessories for babies — romper suits, bodysuits, baby sets.

6302.name: Bed, table and kitchen linen
6302.definition: Made-up household linen — bedsheets, pillow covers, quilt covers, table cloths, napkins, towels.

6301.name: Blankets and travelling rugs
6301.definition: Blankets and rugs of any textile material. Filled quilts and razais are 9404.

6404.name: Shoes with textile uppers
6404.definition: Footwear whose upper is fabric and sole is rubber or plastic — canvas shoes, sports shoes, sneakers.

6403.name: Leather footwear
6403.definition: Footwear with leather uppers — formal shoes, leather sandals, leather boots.

6402.name: Rubber and plastic footwear
6402.definition: Footwear where both the upper and sole are rubber or plastic — slippers, flip-flops, crocs, jellies.

4202.name: Bags, luggage and wallets
4202.definition: Trunks, suitcases, backpacks, handbags, wallets, laptop bags and similar containers.

0401.name: Milk and cream
0401.definition: Fresh, pasteurised or UHT milk and cream, not concentrated or sweetened.

0403.name: Curd, lassi and buttermilk
0403.definition: Fermented milk products — dahi, yoghurt, lassi, chaas, buttermilk.

0405.name: Butter and ghee
0405.definition: Butter, ghee, and dairy spreads derived from milk fat.

0406.name: Cheese and paneer
0406.definition: Cheese of all kinds, plus paneer and chhena. Note that paneer/chhena is nil-rated while other cheese is 5%.

1006.name: Rice
1006.definition: Rice in all forms — paddy, brown, milled, parboiled, basmati. Rate turns on whether it is sold loose or pre-packaged and labelled.

1001.name: Wheat
1001.definition: Wheat grain, whole. Flour milled from it is 1101.

1101.name: Wheat flour (atta, maida)
1101.definition: Flour milled from wheat — atta, maida, suji/rava. Rate turns on loose versus pre-packaged and labelled.

1106.name: Pulse flour (besan)
1106.definition: Flour and meal ground from dried pulses — besan, chana flour.

0713.name: Pulses and dals
0713.definition: Dried leguminous vegetables, shelled — toor, moong, chana, urad, masoor, rajma.

1701.name: Sugar
1701.definition: Cane or beet sugar, refined or raw, including khandsari.

1702.name: Jaggery, gur and glucose
1702.definition: Other sugars and syrups — jaggery, gur, glucose, invert sugar.

1512.name: Sunflower and cottonseed oil
1512.definition: Edible oils pressed from sunflower, safflower or cotton seed.

1514.name: Mustard oil
1514.definition: Oil pressed from rape, colza or mustard seed, refined or not.

0902.name: Tea
0902.definition: Tea leaves and dust, black or green, flavoured or not.

0901.name: Coffee
0901.definition: Coffee beans and ground coffee, roasted or not. Instant coffee is 2101.

0910.name: Turmeric, ginger and mixed spices
0910.definition: Ginger, saffron, turmeric, thyme, bay leaves, curry and other mixed spices and masalas.

0904.name: Pepper and chilli
0904.definition: Pepper of the genus Piper, and dried or crushed chillies.

0909.name: Cumin, coriander and fennel seeds
0909.definition: Seeds of anise, badian, fennel, coriander, cumin and caraway.

2106.name: Food preparations, mixes and supplements
2106.definition: Edible preparations not covered elsewhere — instant mixes, protein supplements, sweeteners, custard powder.

1905.name: Biscuits, bread and bakery
1905.definition: Baked goods — bread, rusk, biscuits, cakes, pastries, khakhra. Plain bread and roti are nil; biscuits and pastry are 5%.

2005.name: Namkeen and savoury snacks
2005.definition: Prepared or preserved vegetable products — namkeen, bhujia, mixture, chips.

2201.name: Packaged drinking water
2201.definition: Water, including mineral and aerated water, with no added sugar or flavour.

2202.name: Soft drinks and aerated beverages
2202.definition: Aerated, carbonated and caffeinated drinks — these carry the 40% demerit rate. Juice-based and plant-milk drinks are 220299 at 5%.

notHere.220299: Fruit juice drinks and plant-based milk

220299.name: Juice-based and plant-milk drinks
220299.definition: Fruit pulp or juice based drinks, and plant-based milk drinks like soy or almond milk.

8517.name: Mobile phones and networking equipment
8517.definition: Telephone sets including smartphones, plus routers, modems and other network apparatus.

8471.name: Computers, laptops and tablets
8471.definition: Automatic data-processing machines — laptops, desktops, tablets, servers and storage units.

8504.name: Chargers, adapters and inverters
8504.definition: Static converters and transformers — phone chargers, laptop adapters, power inverters, UPS.

8507.name: Batteries (rechargeable)
8507.definition: Electric accumulators — lithium-ion packs, power banks, lead-acid and inverter batteries.

8518.name: Speakers, headphones and microphones
8518.definition: Audio apparatus — earphones, headsets, Bluetooth speakers, amplifiers, microphones.

8528.name: Televisions and monitors
8528.definition: Television receivers, monitors and projectors. All screen sizes are 18% since September 2025.

8516.name: Electric heating appliances
8516.definition: Domestic electro-thermal appliances — geysers, irons, kettles, toasters, room heaters, microwave ovens, induction cooktops.

8509.name: Mixers, grinders and small kitchen appliances
8509.definition: Electro-mechanical domestic appliances with a built-in motor — mixer grinders, food processors, juicers, wet grinders.

8415.name: Air conditioners
8415.definition: Air conditioning machines, split or window, with a motor-driven fan.

8418.name: Refrigerators and freezers
8418.definition: Refrigerators, freezers, deep freezers, visi coolers and other refrigerating equipment.

8450.name: Washing machines
8450.definition: Household and laundry-type washing machines, including combined washer-dryers.

9405.name: Lamps, LED bulbs and lighting
9405.definition: Lamps and lighting fittings of all kinds, including LED bulbs, tube lights and decorative lighting.

8544.name: Wires and cables
8544.definition: Insulated wire and cable, including USB and data cables, and optical fibre cables.

8536.name: Switches, sockets and plugs
8536.definition: Electrical apparatus for switching or protecting circuits up to 1000 V — switches, sockets, plugs, MCBs, relays.

3305.name: Shampoo and hair oil
3305.definition: Preparations for use on the hair — shampoo, hair oil, conditioner, hair dye, gel.

3306.name: Toothpaste and oral care
3306.definition: Oral and dental hygiene — toothpaste, toothbrush, tooth powder, mouthwash, dental floss.

3401.name: Soap
3401.definition: Soap and organic surface-active products in bar, cake or liquid form for washing the skin.

3402.name: Detergent and cleaning products
3402.definition: Washing and cleaning preparations — detergent powder and bars, dishwash, floor cleaner, surface cleaner.

3304.name: Cosmetics and skincare
3304.definition: Beauty and make-up preparations, skin-care creams, lotions, sunscreen, lipstick, powder.

9619.name: Sanitary napkins and diapers
9619.definition: Sanitary towels, tampons, napkins, liners and similar articles. Nil-rated.

4818.name: Tissues, toilet paper and diapers
4818.definition: Household paper products — toilet rolls, facial tissues, kitchen towels, baby diapers.

3004.name: Medicines
3004.definition: Medicaments in measured doses — tablets, capsules, syrups, injections, ointments. Some notified life-saving drugs are nil-rated.

3924.name: Plastic kitchenware and household items
3924.definition: Tableware, kitchenware and household articles of plastic — buckets, mugs, storage boxes, tiffin, chairs.

7323.name: Steel utensils and kitchenware
7323.definition: Table, kitchen and household articles of iron or steel — pots, pans, plates, tiffin, scrubbers.

7013.name: Glassware for table and kitchen
7013.definition: Drinking glasses, jars, bowls and other glassware for table, kitchen or bathroom use.

6911.name: Crockery and porcelain tableware
6911.definition: Tableware and kitchenware of porcelain, bone china or ceramic — plates, cups, saucers, dinner sets.

9403.name: Furniture
9403.definition: Furniture of any material other than seats — tables, beds, almirahs, wardrobes, cupboards, shelving.

9401.name: Chairs, sofas and seating
9401.definition: Seats of all kinds and their parts — chairs, sofas, stools, benches, office chairs.

9404.name: Mattresses, quilts and pillows
9404.definition: Mattresses, mattress supports, quilts, razais, pillows and cushions.

6907.name: Tiles
6907.definition: Ceramic flags, paving and wall tiles, glazed or unglazed.

2523.name: Cement
2523.definition: Portland, aluminous, slag and other hydraulic cements.

7213.name: Steel bars and TMT rods
7213.definition: Hot-rolled bars and rods of iron or non-alloy steel, including TMT reinforcement bars.

3208.name: Paint and varnish
3208.definition: Paints and varnishes in a non-aqueous medium, plus solutions and enamels.

9608.name: Pens and refills
9608.definition: Ball-point pens, felt-tip and marker pens, fountain pens and their refills.

4820.name: Notebooks and registers
4820.definition: Exercise books, notebooks, diaries, registers and letter pads. Exercise books and notebooks are nil-rated; commercial registers and diaries are 18%.

4901.name: Books
4901.definition: Printed books, brochures and similar printed matter. Nil-rated.

9503.name: Toys
9503.definition: Toys of all kinds — dolls, puzzles, ride-ons, tricycles, scale models, soft toys.

9506.name: Sports and gym equipment
9506.definition: Articles for general physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and outdoor games.

8712.name: Bicycles
8712.definition: Bicycles and other cycles without a motor, including delivery tricycles.

8711.name: Motorcycles and scooters
8711.definition: Motorcycles, scooters and mopeds. Up to 350cc is 18%; above 350cc carries the 40% rate.

9004.name: Spectacles and sunglasses
9004.definition: Spectacles, goggles and sunglasses, corrective or protective.

9102.name: Watches
9102.definition: Wrist-watches, pocket watches and stop-watches with a non-precious-metal case.

7113.name: Gold and silver jewellery
7113.definition: Articles of jewellery of precious metal. Making charges billed separately attract 5%.

7117.name: Imitation jewellery
7117.definition: Jewellery not containing precious metal — fashion and artificial jewellery.

996331.name: Restaurant and takeaway service
996331.definition: Food and beverage serving at a restaurant, including takeaway. Standalone restaurants are 5% without input tax credit.

996311.name: Hotel room accommodation
996311.definition: Room or unit accommodation in hotels, lodges and guest houses. Tariff up to ₹7,500 per unit per day is 5%; above that, 18%.

998314.name: IT design and development
998314.definition: Software design, development and programming services.

998313.name: IT consulting and support
998313.definition: Information technology consulting, advisory and support services.

998721.name: Computer repair service
998721.definition: Repair and maintenance of computers and peripheral equipment.

998722.name: Mobile repair service
998722.definition: Repair and maintenance of communication equipment, including mobile phones.

998723.name: Appliance repair service
998723.definition: Repair of consumer electronics and household appliances.

999721.name: Salon and beauty parlour
999721.definition: Hairdressing, beauty parlour and grooming services.

996511.name: Goods transport by road
996511.definition: Road transport of goods, including goods transport agency service. Often falls under reverse charge.

997212.name: Commercial property rent
997212.definition: Renting or leasing of own or leased non-residential property — shops, offices, warehouses.

999293.name: Coaching and training
999293.definition: Commercial training and coaching services, not covered by the education exemption.

998361.name: Advertising service
998361.definition: Advertising services, including design and placement of advertisements.

998519.name: Manpower and staffing
998519.definition: Supply of manpower, labour contracting and staffing services.
